changes: Made resolveGitCwd the SOLE entry point for git child-process cwd resolution across 29 production files; added packages/main/src/tasks/gitroot-cwd-contract-smoke.ts that grep-fails on bare-projectRoot/root/metadataRoot git calls outside an explicit allowlist; wired test:gitroot-cwd-contract npm script in root + packages/main package.json. Kills the wrapper-root git-cwd defect class that hit 5 prior stories (B-1637, B-e791, B-0740, B-2856, B-3990) as whack-a-mole single-call-site fixes.
usage: Every new git child-process call in packages/**/*.ts must obtain its cwd from resolveGitCwd. The contract smoke runs in CI; any PR adding `cwd: projectRoot/root/metadataRoot` next to an `execFileSync('git'/spawnSync('git'/execSync('git'` call fails the gate at the offending file:line with a clear remediation pointer at resolveGitCwd.
expectedOutcome: build + e2e + 2 existing wrapper-root smokes (gitroot-cwd-routing B-2856, bare-gate-gitroot-cwd B-3990) + new contract smoke + lattice validate (22/22) all PASS; resolveGitCwd signature unchanged; 3 ad-hoc helpers (runGit/runGitNoThrow) signatures unchanged; over-reach guards (intent-coverage.ts + dev-cli.ts) intact.
actualTranscript: All gates verified green at HEAD: npm run build exit 0; npm run test:e2e ALL PASS (story-lifecycle 5/5 + gap-convergence 4/4); test:gitroot-cwd-routing exit 0 (byte-identical); test:bare-gate-gitroot-cwd exit 0 (byte-identical); test:gitroot-cwd-contract exit 0 (494 .ts files, 0 violations); lattice validate PASS 22/22 intent coverage; resolveGitCwd signature line 195 unchanged; all 3 ad-hoc helpers present; intent-coverage.ts + dev-cli.ts both SAFE; 4 review lanes all PASS across 2 rounds; 2 findings raised + 2 resolved; delivery-check signed.
outcomeDiff: No gap. Choke-point established, contract test gating CI, byte-identical regression smokes still pass.
limitations: Scope bounded: did not touch resolveGitCwd's signature, did not consolidate the 138-smoke runner (#2 separate sub-program), did not modify metadataRoot/gitRoot semantics or koala residual work. The 3 ad-hoc helpers (runGit/runGitNoThrow) were preserved because their cwd-parameter pattern already enforces the contract — only their CALLERS were audited and rerouted.
pitfalls: Lessons from this story: (1) Round-1 quality reviewer caught F-002 — I added a 'callers route via resolveGitCwd' comment in done-effects.ts but the actual caller in transition-orchestrator.ts:273-285 still passed bare ctx.root; aspirational comments are review risk and must be either factual at write time or omitted. (2) PLAN files.modify enumerated 9 top files but the implementer's exhaustive audit found 28 sites needing reroute — for audit stories the files.modify list should be flagged as 'top sample, full list determined in DEV'. (3) scope-check.json was written to the main repo's filesystem by the scope-plan reviewer but not committed; had to manually `cp + git add + commit` it into the worktree before story_review could see it (CLI quirk for wrapper-root reviewer cwds).
